description: Election Commission - Declare that S. Abeygunarathne as a member of the Colombo M/C - Declare that D,. M. C. R. Dasanayaka as a member of the Udapalatha P/S
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Colombo Municipal Council and Udapalatha Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of selected members to fill vacancies created when previous members ceased to be party members. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the electoral process for local authorities.
